clusters.headline: Political Tensions Escalate Across India During Constitution Day
aiSummaryBullets: Political leaders from both the BJP and Congress engaged in verbal exchanges regarding the adherence to and preservation of constitutional principles.
Rallies, torchlight processions, and protest marches took place in several cities, including Delhi, Nagpur, Patna, and Mysuru.

clusters.headline: Union Cabinet Prepares Amended Delimitation Bill For Parliament
aiSummaryBullets: The Union Cabinet is reviewing a proposed constitutional amendment to link the delimitation process with a 33% women's reservation in legislatures.
The legislation seeks to increase the number of Lok Sabha seats from 543 to 850, prompting debate over representation formulas for different states.

clusters.headline: Supreme Court To Review Tirupparankundram Karthigai Deepam Dispute
aiSummaryBullets: The Supreme Court is set to review a legal dispute regarding the Karthigai Deepam lamp lighting ritual at the Subramaniya Swamy Temple.
Contradictory statements from local priests regarding consent for the ritual at the Deepa Mandapam have contributed to the ongoing controversy.

clusters.headline: Supreme Court Sets Aside Allahabad HC Order On Rahul Gandhi Assets
aiSummaryBullets: The Supreme Court of India officially overturned a previous directive issued by the Allahabad High Court.
The overturned high court order had mandated an investigation into the personal assets of politician Rahul Gandhi.

clusters.headline: Mediation Fails In Sunjay Kapur Family Trust Dispute Over Assets
aiSummaryBullets: Court-ordered mediation in the Sunjay Kapur family trust dispute has ended without an agreement.
The legal matter involves claims regarding the value and management of assets within the family trust.

clusters.headline: Congress And Samajwadi Party Halt Uttar Pradesh Seat Negotiations
aiSummaryBullets: Negotiations regarding electoral seat-sharing in Uttar Pradesh have been indefinitely postponed by the Congress and Samajwadi Party.
Internal friction has surfaced within the Congress as party members expressed public frustration regarding the alliance's seat offers.

clusters.headline: Supreme Court Quashes Case Against Rahul Gandhi Over Asset Claims
aiSummaryBullets: The Supreme Court of India canceled Allahabad High Court directives that had requested probes by the CBI and ED into Rahul Gandhi's assets.
Rahul Gandhi recently alleged that his father, Rajiv Gandhi, had his security protection intentionally removed to facilitate his assassination.

clusters.headline: Tamil Nadu CM Vijay Faces Scrutiny Over Harassment And Governance
aiSummaryBullets: A female IAS officer filed a harassment complaint against Kallakurichi TVK MLA C. Arul Vignesh.
Governor Arlekar requested CM Vijay to fill long-standing Vice-Chancellor vacancies in state universities.

clusters.headline: Tamil Nadu Political Uproar Over Harassment Claims Against TVK MLA
aiSummaryBullets: A four-member panel has been established to investigate sexual harassment allegations filed by an IAS officer against MLA C Arul Vignesh.
Opposition parties, including the AIADMK and DMK, are organizing protests and calling for the MLA's arrest and a CBI investigation into the case.

clusters.headline: Vijay Government Announces 15-Day Paternity Leave In Tamil Nadu
aiSummaryBullets: The Tamil Nadu administration has officially launched a 15-day paternity leave program for government workers.
This initiative marks the first time such a policy has been implemented by the state government.

clusters.headline: Punjab Congress Critiques Revived BJP And Shiromani Akali Dal Pact
aiSummaryBullets: Punjab Congress president Pargat Singh predicted the BJP and Shiromani Akali Dal alliance would secure only single-digit seats.
Opposition figures cited historical grievances, including the farmers' protest and religious concerns, as reasons for public discontent.

clusters.headline: India Rejects US Manufacturing Claims Amid New Trade Tariff Threats
aiSummaryBullets: The United States has proposed a 25% tariff on Indian goods following a trade probe into manufacturing capacity.
Indian officials have officially denied allegations of excess manufacturing capacity in domestic sectors.

clusters.headline: Assam Man Rahul Roy Arrested For Alleged Rape Of Nine-Year-Old
aiSummaryBullets: Rahul Roy was apprehended by authorities in Assam after being accused of raping a nine-year-old child.
The suspect had reportedly established a rapport with the victim, who referred to him as 'Baba'.

clusters.headline: Samajwadi Party Leader Azam Khan Discusses Time Spent In Prison
aiSummaryBullets: Azam Khan was released from Ghaziabad prison following the Supreme Court's refusal to intervene in his interim bail.
The Enforcement Directorate had previously appealed to the Supreme Court to challenge the interim bail granted in a money laundering case.

clusters.headline: Centre Confirms Look Out Circular Issued Against Saurav Das
aiSummaryBullets: The Indian government confirmed to the Delhi High Court that a Look Out Circular has been issued against Saurav Das.
Authorities stated that document discrepancies, specifically concerning a passport, may impact his citizenship status.

clusters.headline: Revanth Reddy Sets Congress Target For Telangana 2028 Elections
aiSummaryBullets: Chief Minister Revanth Reddy announced a goal of securing 90 assembly seats and one crore votes in the upcoming 2028 Telangana elections.
The Chief Minister met with the newly appointed AICC in-charge, Sandeep, to discuss party internal discipline and organizational appointments.

clusters.headline: India-Pakistan U19 Cricket Match Controversy Over Neutrality
aiSummaryBullets: Observers raised concerns regarding umpire conduct during the India-Pakistan match following a celebratory gesture toward the Pakistani side.
The Indian cricket team faced criticism for opting to boycott the customary post-match handshake with the Pakistani players.

clusters.headline: Congress Files Delhi High Court Petition Against Meta Content Policy
aiSummaryBullets: The Congress party filed a petition in the Delhi High Court challenging Meta's content moderation practices.
Opposition leaders claim that automated systems are restricting legitimate political content related to Rahul Gandhi.

clusters.headline: Nandini Curd Price Reduced In Karnataka Following Public Backlash
aiSummaryBullets: Nandini brand curd prices decreased by Rs 2 per kilogram.
The price adjustment follows significant public backlash from consumers.

clusters.headline: PM Modi Hailed For Venice Biennale Win As Constitution Day Marked
aiSummaryBullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi recognized India's Venice Biennale pavilion victory while commemorating the nation's Constitution Day.
Diplomatic engagements include discussions with the German Chancellor regarding a pending free trade agreement between India and the European Union.
